entities.summary: Mohamed Bachir El Ibrahimi, also known as Sheikh Bachir El Ibrahimi was an Algerian Islamic scholar known for his important role in Algerian Islamic Reformism especially as one of the seniors of Association of Algerian Muslim Ulema.
